title: prime_import_probe result row
description: One row per dumb-buffer size from prime_import_probe(8). Version 1; an additive change is a minor version, a breaking one a new major kept alongside.

src.description: DRM node the buffer is created on

dst.description: DRM node the buffer is imported on

bytes.description: size of the dumb buffer; 0 when it was not created

create.description: 0 on success, -1 on failure or not tried

stage.description: the step the probe stopped in, done when every step ran

errno.description: errno of the first failing step, 0 when none

error.description: strerror of errno, empty when none
